subject.title: fix(auto-reply): self-heal reply-session-init conflict instead of permanently wedging the session

question: Should maintainers require real patched conflict-recovery proof before treating this PR as the canonical self-heal branch over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: The PR changes generic session lifecycle recovery, and the current evidence is tests plus a normal patched run rather than a real wedged session recovering from the reported conflict.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, terminal output, or Crabbox proof showing a repeated reply-init conflict self-heals and a later message or tool result is delivered.

options.title: Accept test-only risk
options.body: Maintainers can merge based on source review and tests while owning the live recovery uncertainty.

options.title: Defer to the older branch
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 is preferred, make that branch canonical and pause this duplicate candidate until the canonical path is proof-positive or merged.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, terminal output, or Crabbox proof showing a repeated reply-init conflict self-heals and a later message or tool result is delivered.

likelyOwner.reason: Their reply-session initialization serialization work is the strongest ownership signal for the conflict path.
